06-25-1533 is June 25, 1533.  
Subtract 176 days:  
May has 31 days, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1533 is not a leap year, 1500 was not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
From June 25 back 25 days → May 31.  
Remaining 176 − 25 = 151 days earlier.  
May 31 back 31 days → April 30.  
Remaining 151 − 31 = 120 days earlier.  
April 30 back 30 days → March 31.  
Remaining 120 − 30 = 90 days earlier.  
March 31 back 31 days → February 28.  
Remaining 90 − 31 = 59 days earlier.  
February 28 back 28 days → January 31.  
Remaining 59 − 28 = 31 days earlier.  
January 31 back 31 days → December 31, 1532.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1532-12-31
